clue.text: Falls in canal, unfortunately! Ann's taken out all bloated with water

parts.note: falls as a noun are drops, as in drops of rain or drops in level

indicators.note: unfortunately suggests things have gone awry, so the letters of in canal are jumbled

parts.note: the girl's name Ann, whose letters are the ones taken out of the jumble

explanation.surface: Someone tumbles into a canal and comes out waterlogged, Ann having been fished out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'taken out' is a second signal: Ann's letters are removed from the shuffled pool. The surface pretends someone fell in a canal.
explanation.definitionFit: Dropsy is the old medical term for oedema, a swelling from retained fluid, so dropsical describes a body swollen with it.

clue.text: Experimenting with that drug is crazy

indicators.note: experimenting with something means trying it in new arrangements, so these words are rearranged

explanation.surface: A warning that dabbling with that drug is madness.
explanation.definitionFit: Distraught means frantic with worry, close to out of one's mind, a sense near enough to crazy.

clue.text: There's no let-up, abusing the rich

indicators.note: abusing something means mistreating or twisting it, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A complaint that the wealthy are under relentless attack.
explanation.definitionFit: Opulent is a synonym for wealthy or luxurious.

clue.text: Not at all hard on a student in the mosque

parts.note: the opposite of hard is soft

explanation.surface: A gentle remark about going easy on a young scholar at the mosque.
explanation.walkthrough: A softa is a student of Islamic law and theology, a word used chiefly in Ottoman Turkey.
explanation.definitionFit: A softa is a Muslim theological pupil attached to a mosque school.

clue.text: Tears come -I'm contriving to demonstrate pity

indicators.note: contriving means devising or arranging, so these letters are arranged afresh

explanation.surface: Someone forces out tears to put on a show of sympathy.
explanation.definitionFit: To commiserate is to express sympathy or sorrow for another's misfortune.

clue.text: In Georgia, money I take out to get statue of a god

indicators.note: take out means remove, so the letter named by I is dropped from the currency

parts.note: the lari is the currency of the republic of Georgia

explanation.surface: A traveller in Georgia withdraws cash to buy a religious figurine.
explanation.walkthrough: The Georgia meant is the Caucasian republic, whose currency is the lari, not the US state.
explanation.definitionFit: A lar was a Roman household deity, represented by a small figure kept in the home shrine.

clue.text: Something valuable a girl sent back

indicators.note: sent back means returned the other way, so the girl's name is read backwards

parts.note: Tess is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A precious item that a young woman returned.
explanation.definitionFit: An asset is a useful or valuable possession.

clue.text: Godless man is presented in classically elegant style

indicators.note: presented in means placed within, so the man and is go inside the style

parts.note: Attic describes the simple, refined style of ancient Athens
he is the pronoun for a man
taken as written

explanation.surface: A nonbeliever is introduced in a polished classical manner.
explanation.definitionFit: Atheistic means denying the existence of any deity.

clue.text: Family member gripping hard on girl in the river

indicators.note: gripping means holding tight around, so the son encloses the other pieces

parts.note: a son is a member of a family
H is the abbreviation for hard, as on pencils
Ann is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A son holds his sister firmly as they wade in a river.
explanation.definitionFit: The Shannon is Ireland's longest river.

clue.text: Gallery writing thank-you note

parts.note: ta is informal British for thanks
te is a note of the sol-fa scale

explanation.surface: An art gallery is sent a written thank-you.
explanation.definitionFit: The Tate is a group of London art museums.

clue.text: Extinguish the light with this powder?

definitions.meaning: to put out a candle flame

explanation.definitionFit: Snuff is both a verb for putting out a candle and finely ground tobacco inhaled through the nose.

clue.text: Army manoeuvre for which chart and maps are required

indicators.note: these words are needed but only once reorganised, so the letters of chart and maps are rearranged

explanation.surface: Planning a military exercise calls for charts and maps.
explanation.walkthrough: The anagram signal is weak: 'are required' asks for chart and maps to be reworked into the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A march past is a ceremonial parade of troops filing past a saluting point.

clue.text: Looking into it again — needing an exit? I'm near roundabout

indicators.note: roundabout means circuitous, going round, so the letters are turned about into a new order

parts.note: as printed these words lack the O the answer needs; the setter's fodder is taken as these words plus O

explanation.surface: A driver going round a roundabout looks for a way off.
explanation.walkthrough: As printed the fodder lacks an O; the setter probably meant the roundabout's ring shape to supply it as well as signal the anagram.
explanation.definitionFit: A re-examination is a second inspection or scrutiny of something.

clue.text: Not in favour of church dignitary greeting trade-union leaders? It's a plant!

parts.note: anti means against
RR stands for Right Reverend, the style of a bishop
hi is a greeting
the NUM, National Union of Mineworkers, was a British trade union with famous leaders

explanation.surface: Someone opposed to a bishop saying hello to union bosses discovers a flower.
explanation.walkthrough: The NUM was Britain's National Union of Mineworkers.
explanation.definitionFit: Antirrhinum is the botanical name for the snapdragon, a garden flower.

clue.text: Drops of hard water

parts.note: reads like limescale-laden tap water, but means water frozen solid falling as pellets

explanation.definitionFit: Hail is precipitation of ice pellets, so each one is a frozen raindrop.

clue.text: Ravel to be dealt with? Succeed in playing tune

indicators.note: in means placed within, so the success goes inside the scrambled tune
playing a tune means performing it freely, so the letters of tune are rearranged

parts.note: to win is to succeed

explanation.surface: A musician tackles Ravel and triumphs in performing the melody.
explanation.walkthrough: Ravel looks like the French composer, but here it is the verb meaning to tangle, and the definition asks what undoes it.
explanation.definitionFit: To untwine is to separate twisted strands, the remedy for a tangled ravel.

clue.text: Who may have gone deepest? Not miners, misdirected

indicators.note: misdirected means sent the wrong way, so the letters of not miners are rearranged

explanation.surface: A riddle about which people go down furthest, ruling out coal miners.
explanation.definitionFit: Innermost means furthest in, the description of whoever has gone deepest.

clue.text: Little bird, one included in a bust of a queen

annotationWithheld.why: Little bird, one included in a bust of a queen: TIT gives the start, but no reading of 'one included in a bust' gives ANIA; the clue looks garbled by OCR
annotationWithheld.clue: Little bird, one included in a bust of a queen

clue.text: One word of praise

parts.note: a single exclamation of worship, as sung in church

explanation.definitionFit: Hosanna is a shout of adoration to God used in Christian liturgy.

clue.text: Plotted absurdly macho deeds without ado

indicators.note: absurdly means ridiculously, so the letters of macho deeds are scrambled

parts.note: the letters of ado are removed from the mix

explanation.surface: Someone arranged ridiculous acts of bravado without any fuss.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' tells you the letters of ADO come out of the jumble of MACHO DEEDS.
explanation.definitionFit: Schemed means conspired or devised a secret plan.

clue.text: Moving article, .revealing statement of facts

indicators.note: moving letters around means rearranging them, so article is shuffled

explanation.surface: A touching newspaper piece reveals the truth.
explanation.definitionFit: A recital is a detailed account or narration of events.

clue.text: Can King, Queen and Head of State have mackerel?

parts.note: a can is a tin
K is the chess abbreviation for king
ER stands for Elizabeth Regina

indicators.note: head of means the first letter, so the opening of state is taken

explanation.surface: Royals and a head of state are offered fish at a banquet.
explanation.walkthrough: A tinker is a dialect name for a young mackerel.
explanation.definitionFit: Young mackerel are known in some regions as tinkers.

clue.text: The sour stench put out by this inedible fruit

indicators.note: put out means disturbed, so the letters of the sour stench are rearranged

explanation.surface: An unpleasant smell given off by an uneatable fruit.
explanation.definitionFit: A conker, the seed of a common tree, is poisonous and inedible, unlike the sweet chestnut.

clue.text: Very good to get in deep shade

indicators.note: to get in means entering, so the goodness goes inside the deep

parts.note: the deep is the sea
pi is slang for pious, very good

explanation.surface: Something excellent lies in deep shadow.
explanation.definitionFit: Sepia is a reddish-brown colour, as in old photographs.

clue.text: Unnoticeable part of the ear

indicators.note: part means a portion, so the letters sit inside unnoticeable

explanation.surface: A tiny, barely visible section of the ear.
explanation.definitionFit: Otic is the medical adjective relating to hearing organs.

clue.text: Break into rumba, taking up its beat?

indicators.note: break means smash, so the letters of into and rumba are scattered

explanation.surface: A dancer breaks into a rumba, picking up its rhythm.
explanation.walkthrough: A tambourin is a long Provençal drum, the instrument you take up to sound a dance's beat.
explanation.definitionFit: A drum is played to keep a dance rhythm, hence the cryptic hint.

clue.text: Legendary flier crocodile's eaten

indicators.note: eaten means swallowed, so the bird is inside the crocodile word

explanation.surface: A mythical bird has been devoured by a crocodile.
explanation.definitionFit: The roc is a giant bird of Arabian myth, as in Sinbad's tales.

clue.text: Groom seen to peer around at beginning of nuptials

indicators.note: around means turned about, so the letters of peer are rearranged
the first letter of nuptials is taken

explanation.surface: A bridegroom is seen glancing round as the wedding begins.
explanation.definitionFit: To preen is to groom oneself carefully, like a bird with its feathers.

clue.text: Trainee acted irregularly

indicators.note: irregularly means out of the usual order, so the letters of acted are jumbled

explanation.surface: A recruit behaved out of line.
explanation.definitionFit: A cadet is a young person training for the armed forces or police.

clue.text: Arrives, crossing the oof — they're to measure the distance

indicators.note: crossing means lying across, so arrives straddles the mountain pass

parts.note: arrives means comes
a col is a mountain pass

explanation.surface: A traveller gets over the mountain pass with instruments for measuring the distance.
explanation.definitionFit: Compasses are a hinged drawing instrument for marking off distances on a map.
